cycle_ledger.method: Guest elapsed Z80-base-equivalent cycles, IRQ/VDP waits included. Work=GameTurbo_Loop to wait_blank; period=FrameDone to FrameDone. Active intervals exclude death/stopped/cold-epoch crossings. Inclusive, self unmeasured; never add work and period. Cold only separately scoped.
cycle_ledger.vblank: No new usable-VBlank bound measured;5000-cycle reserve remains an assumption.
cycle_ledger.remaining_budget: Per-sample two-refresh budget minus inclusive work; negative values are overloads, not extra VBlank.
